# Healthline

> > Healthline is a trusted medical information platform providing evidence-based health guidance, nutrition advice, mental wellness resources, and chronic condition management tools.

Operated by RVO Health (formerly Red Ventures), Healthline offers comprehensive health content covering wellness, nutrition, mental health, and medical conditions. The platform includes specialized resources like Healthline Lessons for chronic disease education, Bezzy community support networks, and partnerships with organizations like the FDA and CDC to deliver medically reviewed health information.

## Core Resources

- [Healthline: Medical information and health advice you can trust.](https://healthline.com): Homepage: Expert health guidance for wellness, conditions, and nutrition

- [Healthline Nutrition — Healthy Eating in Real Life](https://healthline.com/nutrition): Nutrition hub for healthy eating, meal prep, diets, and supplements
- [Healthline Lessons](https://learn.healthline.com): Free educational program for chronic condition management by RVO Health
- [Top Health News: Technology, Mental Health and More](https://healthline.com/health-news): Latest health news on obesity, sleep apnea, cannabis, and medical research
- [Healthline Videos](https://healthline.com/video): Video library of health tutorials and wellness education content

- [Food & Nutrition](https://healthline.com/health/food-nutrition): Nutrition overview covering balanced diet, vitamins, and dietary guidelines

## Chronic Conditions & Disease Management

- [18 Ways to Lower Your Blood Pressure](https://healthline.com/health/high-blood-pressure-hypertension/lower-it-fast): Hypertension management through lifestyle changes and dietary modifications
- [Can You Unclog and Reduce Plaque in Arteries?](https://healthline.com/health/heart-disease/how-to-unclog-arteries): Atherosclerosis treatment with DASH diet and lifestyle interventions
- [How to Stop a Panic Attack](https://healthline.com/health/how-to-stop-a-panic-attack): Anxiety management with CBT, breathing exercises, and mindfulness techniques
- [Stress: What It Does to The Body](https://healthline.com/health/stress/effects-on-body): Chronic stress effects on cardiovascular health and nervous system function
- [ADHD Symptoms in Teens, Diagnosis, Treatment, and Coping](https://healthline.com/health/adhd/adhd-symptoms-in-teens): Teen ADHD guide covering symptoms, diagnosis, and behavioral management
- [9 Mistakes People Make When Talking About Rheumatoid Arthritis](https://healthline.com/health/rheumatoid-arthritis/mistakes-people-make-when-talking-about-rheumatoid-arthritis): RA communication etiquette and chronic illness conversation tips
